name: S. Confusa
description: Formerly called, first kewensis, and later, diplotricha. A single crowned plant which has a tendency to grow one-sided, with small, slightly serrated, almost round, grayish-green leaves. Small light blue to violet flowers.

name: S. Difficilis
description: Also known as "Kenya" and "Tanga."' A single crown plant of upright growth, rather long stems, longish pointed leaves with very distinct veins. Medium sized blue single flowers.

name: S. Diplotricha
description: Is also known as "Mkulu-muzu."' A smallish flat rosette single crown type. Rather thick-textured leaves a little more than an inch long, slightly serrated, slightly pointed, and inclined to spoon. Pale-blue, almost white, single blossoms.

name: S. Goetzeana
description: A small growing pincushion type with many short branches. Small dark oval leaves. Blossoms are said to be a lilac single.

name: S. Grandifolia
description: Upright, rather large, single crown plant with long flexible petioles, thin textured, oval, medium sized leaves. Has medium blue single blossoms. Is also known as "Lutinde."

name: S. Grotei
description: Is generally called a climber, but is really a trailer. Multiple crowned, with long flexible petioles and thin leaves. Medium blue single, with long flower stems.

name: S. Intermedia
description: A single crown, upright growing plant, with olive-green, almost round, slightly serrated leaves. Blue single.

name: S. Ionantha
description: An ordinary looking plant, upright, single crown. Oval leaves with long stems. Medium blue single.

name: S. Magungensis
description: A trailer, with creeping brown stems, many short branches, and small heart-shaped leaves with beautiful veining. Outer row of leaves apt to bend down at an acute angle. Medium violet-blue single with darker center.

name: S. Nitida
description: Single crown, upright growth. Small, medium dark green, smooth, oval leaves on slender flexible brown stems. Blue single.

name: S. Orbicularis
description: Upright growth. Rather small roundish leaves on long thin flexible stems. Small light lilac single, with darker center.

name: S. Pendula
description: Single crown, upright growth. Grayish-green, almost round, slightly serrated leaves. Blue single.

name: S. Shumensis
description: Midget type. Multiple crown, rather flat growth, with small, almost round, slightly serrated leaves: Short petioles and almost white flowers.

name: S. Tongwensis
description: Single crown, apt to be one-sided. Rather long narrow leaves. On some plants the leaves have a paler green streak down the center. Pale-blue single.

name: S. Velutina
description: Also called "Coxiensis" and "H-C-ensis." Upright growth, long flexible stems, heart-shaped, slightly furry, finely scalloped leaves, with red-backs and stems and pronounced veining. Small blue flower.
